title: 17th Field Artillery Regiment HIMARS live fire at Combined Arms Training Center Camp Fuji
description: U.S. Army Soldiers assigned to 17th Field Artillery Regiment conduct High Mobility Artillery Rocket System (HIMARS) training during a live fire exercise at CATC Camp Fuji Oct. 28, 2026. The exercise demonstrates the U.S. Army's commitment to maintaining a ready and capable force in the Indo-Pacific. (U.S. Air Force video by Senior Airman Austin Salazar)
credit: U.S. Air Force video by Senior Airman Austin Salazar

transcript.text: US soldiers conduct time-war training at Combined Arms Training Center Camp Fuji
Sergeant First Class Smith provides more information.
